# Review beneficial ownership reporting

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When an entity is formed, ownership or control changes, or a reporting regime changes. A dated applicability decision and, where required, an authorized filing receipt and update schedule.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

- Sources: [FinCEN beneficial ownership reporting](https://www.fincen.gov/boi) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

## Outcomes

- A dated applicability decision and, where required, an authorized filing receipt and update schedule.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Compile entity, ownership and control facts

agent-runnable


Gather the legal entity, formation and registration locations, ownership chain and relevant control arrangements. Keep identity documents in a restricted workspace and record facts still needing confirmation.

- Sources: [FinCEN beneficial ownership reporting](https://www.fincen.gov/boi) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Determine which regimes apply now

human · human approval required


Local counsel checks each relevant authority for current scope, exemptions, court or rule changes and update duties. Record the dated decision for this entity; incorporation alone does not establish a universal filing requirement.

- Sources: [FinCEN beneficial ownership reporting](https://www.fincen.gov/boi) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare only the required information

agent-runnable


Build the authority-specific submission pack from verified identity and ownership records. Check indirect holdings and missing information with counsel rather than inferring a beneficial owner from the cap table alone.

- Sources: [FinCEN beneficial ownership reporting](https://www.fincen.gov/boi) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Submit an authorized filing where required

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


The authorized filer approves the final declarations and uses the official channel for the applicable regime. Retain the receipt and any rejection or correction request; do not submit for a regime counsel has determined inapplicable.

- Sources: [FinCEN beneficial ownership reporting](https://www.fincen.gov/boi) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Maintain the decision and change-monitoring record

agent-runnable


Record the filing outcome or documented non-applicability, access controls and events that trigger reassessment. Assign responsibility for changes instead of treating the initial assessment as permanent.

- Verify: A dated applicability decision and, where required, an authorized filing receipt and update schedule.
- Sources: [FinCEN beneficial ownership reporting](https://www.fincen.gov/boi) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)
